common.tagline: Reservations and QR tickets for clubs, cafés and restaurants.

home.title: Your venue. Your link. Your reservations.
home.subtitle: Book a table or a party, then show the QR at the door.
home.step1Body: damjan.ulaznice.rs, kafe123.ulaznice.rs — everyone sees and manages only their own.
home.step2Body: Reserve online, pay at the door. The ticket arrives as a QR code.
home.step3Body: Staff confirm the reservation, check-in and payment status.
